name: PTP client synchronization status
aliases: substations Substation timing and event interfaces
summary: Reports whether the assigned device accepts its required network time reference.
description: Reports whether the assigned device accepts its required network time reference. A station time system provides a shared time reference for protection records, measurements and automation. Different devices can use different timing protocols, so the time source, distribution path and quality information must remain identifiable.

In a substation, a station clock can provide precision timing to process equipment and another timing interface to event recorders. The alarm system should distinguish loss of a distribution path from loss of the external time source. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Client time synchronization” at the input and “Synchronized or unsynchronized state” at the output. The accepted accuracy must match the application.

Show the source and client of each time connection. Required accuracy, holdover, protocol profile and loss-of-time behavior follow the selected application; a common timestamp format does not guarantee synchronized events.
